{"diagnosis": "Loopback RX recv_buf_data latched 0xd2 instead of expected 0xa5, causing TRAP uart data mismatch. Receiver in recv_state 1 waits `recv_divcnt > cfg_divider` for the start bit, i.e. a full bit period instead of half-bit alignment. This offsets all subsequent data samples in default state toward bit edges causing bit-slip from recv_pattern to recv_buf_data.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picosoc/simpleuart.v b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
--- a/picosoc/simpleuart.v
+++ b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
@@ -83,5 +83,5 @@
 				1: begin
-					if (recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) begin
+					if (recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 1)) begin
 						recv_state <= 2;
 						recv_divcnt <= 0;
 					end
", "expected": "tohost PASS (replacing FAIL 0xdead), TRAP gone / uart data got 0xa5 want 0xa5, checksum changes from 7ead7d9c1ebd862283bf0991c6a01fd4f7dad63f24f2be953b7f57e1f7edd073"}

Receiver in recv_state 1 waits `recv_divcnt > cfg_divider` for the start bit, i.e. a full bit period instead of half-bit alignment.
